ios.name: ScoutX
ios.subtitle: Your Football Passport
ios.description:
ScoutX is the player-first football identity platform for players aged 13 and over. Build your Football Passport from your match logs, highlight videos, movement sessions, development goals and coach endorsements, with every item showing where it came from, so scouts see evidence, not hype.

Players aged 13 to 17 need a parent or guardian to approve youth features, and every public or scout-facing feature is a separate permission. ScoutX does not track your location: movement sessions measure distance and a pitch heatmap on your phone and store no location. ScoutX does not guarantee trials, contracts or selection.

ageRating.messagingNote: No open chat. Scouts can send structured requests and trial invitations with a short text (max 500 characters); requests to players aged 13-17 need guardian permission and notify the guardian.
ageRating.ageAssurance: Self-declared age band; under 13 blocked; guardian approval for 13-17.
ageRating.notes: LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: confirm the questionnaire answers in App Store Connect match this block.
